cases.name: Fresh install to first useful action
failures: Visible LiteRT thinking protocol marker in normal assistant reply; parser-boundary regression requires focused follow-up (#1418)
cases.notes: Fresh clean-install Journey 1 on physical S21 (SM-G991B, Android 15/API 35) using the exact merged-main debug APK. The first launch showed and accepted the Android notification permission prompt; home rendered normally. Deterministic pre-model get_time returned the current time. Model availability auto-queued Gemma 4 E-2B; one force-stop interruption resumed from persisted byte 521892826 and continued, then completed gemma-4-E2B-it.litertlm. The model card showed Ready. Normal local GPU chat did generate complete responses (Kia ora! Hello there. What's on your mind today? and No worries.; TTFT 29037ms/37113ms), but the first assistant bubble visibly included the raw protocol marker </|/think|> after the greeting. The visible marker means the clean first-response acceptance is not proven and Journey 1 remains partial. No app-process crash or ANR observed; background FGS notification warnings were non-blocking platform diagnostics. Existing S21 Journey 2 baseline evidence was not overwritten.

cases.notes: Non-destructive adb install -r preserved the populated fixture, E4B cache, seeded list/item, conversations, messages, memories, notes, and shortcuts. Force-stop/relaunch completed without a model re-download loop.

cases.name: Weather and location fallback
failures: Chat weather repair flow did not open Android Settings
cases.notes: Denied chat weather truthfully returned a location capability-required result. The dialog offered Use my location, Use a named location, and Not now, but no Settings link. External Settings restoration and normal return produced a genuine local-weather result.

cases.name: Push-to-talk and spoken response
cases.notes: Exact merged-main debug APK on S23U (device runtime observed as Android 16/API 36; dashboard device registry retains canonical S23 Ultra API 35 identity): Hey Jandal remained enabled, Inflect Micro remained selected and Ready, three bounded unattended voice turns rendered and spoke through Inflect Micro, Stop interrupted a longer reply cleanly, a subsequent turn spoke, HOME/resume preserved the route, and user-confirmed normal PTT produced transcript plus spoken answer. No app crash or ANR observed. Android TTS remained available as fallback but was not needed.

cases.name: Permission revocation and repair
failures: Full microphone-plus-location repair contract not complete
cases.notes: Microphone revocation showed the accurate microphone-removed repair dialog; permission restoration returned to Jandal and restarted Hey safely. Location denial, external restore, return, and retry also worked, but the required app-directed Settings repair action was not available on chat weather.
